$comment: Project classification for the solution views. tools/solutions/generate-solutions.py reads this file and bodu.slnx and writes the bodu.*.slnx views; the views themselves hold no logic. See tools/solutions/README.md and plans/multi-solution-architecture.md.

kinds.library: A production library under <Project>/src/: shipping, or packable and withheld from nuget.org by bld/release-manifest.txt.
kinds.test: A runnable MSTest project of a library: IsTestProject is true and the file is named *.Test.csproj.
kinds.tooling: A build-time or command-line component that is not a library: the calendar rule-pack tool and MSBuild task, and the source generator.
kinds.tooling-test: A runnable MSTest project of a tooling component.
kinds.test-support: A project referenced by tests that is not itself a runnable test suite: contract bases and shared test data.
kinds.test-fixture: A project a test builds and loads at run time rather than compiles against.
kinds.aot-smoke: A native AOT smoke application that a dedicated workflow publishes.
kinds.sample-test: A runnable MSTest project under samples/ that tests a sample.

views.purpose: Production library build: every library, and nothing else.
Standard test suite: every runnable test project CI runs, with what they reference.
Performance investigations: the benchmark harnesses and the libraries they measure.
Samples and example verification: the samples, their tests, and what they reference.
Specialist utilities: the toolchain, the source generator, their tests, the AOT smoke app, and the docs project.

exceptions.reason: The shared test harness. It has tests of its own, and every domain's tests reference it, so it reaches each domain view through references rather than through ownership.
The bodu-calendar command-line tool (PackAsTool), withheld from nuget.org; not a library.
The CompileNotableDatePack MSBuild task (netstandard2.0, DevelopmentDependency), withheld from nuget.org; not a library.
A Roslyn source generator (netstandard2.0, not yet packable) that consumers load as an analyzer; not a library.
The exchange-rate provider contract-test bases. It lives under src/ and sets IsTestProject, but holds only abstract bases, so CI does not run it.
Shared assertions for the regional calendar data test projects (IsTestProject is false).

Plugin assemblies the plugin loader tests build and load at run time (Bodu.Globalization.Calendar.Plugins.Test references them with ReferenceOutputAssembly=false). Visual Studio builds them only when they are in the opened solution.
Published with PublishAot=true by numerics-aot-smoke.yml; runs under the JIT in ordinary builds.
A content-only project that shows docs/ in the IDE; the API site is built by bld/docs/build-api-docs.sh.

notInMaster.reason: The Bodu.CodeStyle analyzers are an independent solution (Bodu.CodeStyle/Bodu.CodeStyle.sln) with their own global.json.
A maintenance generator run by hand (dotnet run --project) to regenerate the ISO 4217 currency types. Kept out of the master so the release pack, which builds bodu.slnx, never builds it.
A maintenance generator run by hand to regenerate the Hijri observance test vectors. Kept out of the master for the same reason.

externalReferences.reason: Bodu.Core loads the in-repo XML-documentation analyzer and code fix from source (OutputItemType=Analyzer, ReferenceOutputAssembly=false) to exercise BODU1405. Those projects belong to the separate Bodu.CodeStyle solution; bodu.slnx does not list them and neither do the views. A command-line build still builds them through the reference.

legacyMasterBuildExclusions.reason: bodu.slnx excludes these projects from its Debug configuration (<Build Solution="Debug|*" Project="false" />). The views never carry the exclusion. It stays in the master until each project's Debug build has been confirmed in the IDE (plans/multi-solution-architecture.md, section 6); the list is exact, so a new exclusion fails the check.
